tui.notices.reasoning_echo_filled.note: EN-only context sidecar; emitted when a provider refuses a missing reasoning echo and the loop retries with it filled

tui.notices.reasoning_echo_thinking_off.note: EN-only context sidecar; the retry disables thinking instead of filling the echo

tui.notices.budget_exhausted_retry.note: EN-only context sidecar; {effort} is the lowered reasoning rung; the operator's own setting is unchanged

tui.notices.budget_exhausted_continue.note: EN-only context sidecar; re-asks without lowering effort

tui.notices.budget_exhausted_no_output.note: EN-only context sidecar; {cause} names why no visible output arrived

tui.notices.output_limit_continuing.note: EN-only context sidecar; the turn resumes from the cut point

tui.notices.output_limit_cut_off.note: EN-only context sidecar; the remainder was never sent and the operator must ask again

tui.notices.output_limit_tool_call.note: EN-only context sidecar; the call was cut mid-argument and never executed

tui.notices.output_limit_before_call.note: EN-only context sidecar; the call never ran and is re-issued unchanged

tui.notices.empty_reply.note: EN-only context sidecar; the reply had neither prose nor tool calls

tui.notices.repeated_tool_errors.note: EN-only context sidecar; the loop asks the model for a different approach

tui.notices.kept_going_stopped.note: EN-only context sidecar; the continuation limit stopped the turn and dropped the pending message
